column3: “Shaped” supplies the action of the craftsman.
“Kingdoms” is plural instead of a collective singular.
Being instructed by wooden idols interprets the nominal phrase about instruction, vanities, and wood.
“This earth” supplies a demonstrative, while the Hebrew marks these heavens.
“Thunders” specifies giving His voice; “ends” is plural instead of singular.
Molten images are plural instead of singular.
“My” and “must” are supplied to the sickness and its bearing.
“Bring me to nothing” intensifies making me small.
